status_detail: Gold recorded (47). Deterministic audit run complete (temperature 0, frozen pipeline, real provider): citation-resolution, full abstention/false-abstention, top-10 recall (not pilot-comparable), and the coverage grid are computed. The three recorded gate-conflicts land exactly (mq28 false-abstention; mq43, mq44 false-answer). Claim-level sentence support (N2) is now recorded: each of the 304 kept sentences was read against its cited page text; strict (fully-supported only) = 298/304 = 0.980, lenient (supported or partly) = 304/304 = 1.000, 0 not-supported -- both clear the 0.90 bar. Six 'partly' sentences and two gate scope-flags are itemized in reports/microlog/judgment_decided.json for the author's review.
